resources.string: Flipping Cards: The player taps a face-down card to reveal it (first selection of the turn).

Pair Validation: If the two cards show the same image, they remain face up, the player earns points, and the count of found pairs increases. If they are different, they flip back over after a brief moment.
Attempts: The player has a limited number of errors/attempts. Each error reduces the counter of remaining lives or attempts.
Scoring: Each pair found adds points to the players overall score.
